scope: F1/F2/F9/F10 arithmetic and public-source verification only; no candidate strategy prices, signals, returns or authenticated requests.

classifications.F1_under_two_years_in_most_rising_market: unsupported as a general or probabilistic claim; conditional smooth-growth arithmetic only
classifications.F2_t3_at_25bp_N2670: verified arithmetic conditional on unverified volatility/count/covariance inputs
classifications.F2_25bp_published_long_only_sigma: unsupported as a direct published measurement; published half-hour scale is available
classifications.F2_A2_3_9percent_to_1_5bp: conditional approximation; exact only under specified equal-positive-full-year/constant-daily scenarios
classifications.F2_MDE_at_80_90percent: conditional normal and iid noncentral-t planning calculations; no HAC gate power guarantee
classifications.F9_100pages_per_feed: conditional approximately 105 regular-session full-page equivalents; not verified total API requests
classifications.F10_shared_window_multiple_testing: valid methodological concern; numerical family-size illustrations are hypothetical, not actual tested count

inputs.window_context_only: proposed 2016-01-04 or fallback 2016-01-05 through 2026-09-30; neither count verified here
inputs.whole_calendar_definition: all eligible full sessions including zero-return no-trade sessions, not civil days
inputs.hac_gate_context: draft r7 intercept-only mean, Bartlett five lags, correction setting must be frozen; planning computations do not estimate HAC
inputs.benchmark_cagrs: explicit external assumptions on after-tax common basis, not observed/forecast SPY returns

formulas.iid_student_t_power: nct.sf(3, df=N-1, nc=mean_bp*sqrt(N)/sigma_bp); iid Gaussian surrogate, not HAC
formulas.year_tax_ledger: W_after_year/W_start_year = 1+R_year-0.24*max(R_year,0); multiply year factors then annualize by actual elapsed years, including taxed terminal partial year
formulas.a2_equal_positive_full_years: R_pre = 0.03/(1-0.24); linear mean proxy=R_pre/252; constant daily rate=(1+R_pre)**(1/252)-1
formulas.last_half_hour_sigma_conversion: sigma_daily_bp=0.0621/sqrt(252)*10000; sqrt252 is the standard annualized-SD conversion assumption
formulas.long_only_variance_identity: Var(I*R)=q*E[R**2|I=1]-q**2*E[R|I=1]**2; unconditional half-hour SD alone does not identify it
formulas.hac_long_run_variance: Omega=gamma0+2*sum(gamma_k,k>=1); SE(mean)~=sqrt(Omega/N). Five-lag Bartlett uses gamma0+2*sum((1-k/6)*gamma_k,k=1..5), before finite-sample correction
formulas.relative_stop: relative_wealth=(1.03/(1+b))**t; crossing t=log(0.85)/log(1.03/(1+b)), for b>0.03; quarter-aligned first check=ceil(4*t)/4
formulas.page_equivalent: ceil(assumed_dates*minutes_per_date/10000); actual requests depend on query partitioning and underfilled pages
formulas.independent_repetition: FWER=1-(1-alpha)**m; arbitrary-dependence union bound<=min(1,m*alpha) if each marginal test is valid

sources.identity: Gao et al., Market intraday momentum, JFE 129 (2018) 394-414, DOI 10.1016/j.jfineco.2018.05.009
sources.sample: 1993-02-01 through 2013-12-31; final publication 2018, not a pre-2016 published manuscript
sources.retrieval: public unauthenticated urllib download, PDF only in /tmp

reproduction_python:
from math import ceil, log, sqrt
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm, nct
N, sigma_bp, threshold, sessions_per_year = 2670, 25.0, 3.0, 252
q, round_trip_bp, tax, after_tax_target = 0.5, 2.0, 0.24, 0.03
se = sigma_bp / sqrt(N)
alpha = float(norm.sf(threshold))
output = {
    "a1": {
        "iid_standard_error_bp_per_session": se,
        "nominal_mean_over_se_3_net_bp_per_session": threshold * se,
        "annual_arithmetic_net_at_threshold": threshold * se * sessions_per_year / 10000,
        "net_bp_per_trade_at_threshold": threshold * se / q,
        "gross_bp_per_trade_at_threshold": threshold * se / q + round_trip_bp,
        "one_sided_standard_normal_alpha": alpha,
        "power_at_nominal_mean_over_se_3_normal": float(norm.sf(0)),
        "power_at_noncentrality_3_iid_student_t": float(nct.sf(threshold, N - 1, threshold)),
    },
    "mde": [],
    "a2": {},
    "published_scale": {},
    "relative_stop": [],
    "pages_per_feed": [],
    "repeated_test_illustrations": [],
    "hac_ar1_illustrations": [],
}
for power in [0.8, 0.9]:
    z_power = float(norm.ppf(power))
    normal_mde = (threshold + z_power) * se
    noncentrality = brentq(lambda nc: nct.sf(threshold, N - 1, nc) - power, 0, 20)
    output["mde"].append({
        "power": power,
        "z_power": z_power,
        "normal_net_bp_per_session": normal_mde,
        "iid_noncentral_t_noncentrality": noncentrality,
        "iid_noncentral_t_net_bp_per_session": noncentrality * se,
        "normal_net_bp_per_trade": normal_mde / q,
        "normal_gross_bp_per_trade": normal_mde / q + round_trip_bp,
        "iid_noncentral_t_gross_bp_per_trade": noncentrality * se / q + round_trip_bp,
    })
    assert abs(nct.sf(threshold, N - 1, noncentrality) - power) < 1e-10
annual_pretax = after_tax_target / (1 - tax)
linear_daily = annual_pretax / sessions_per_year * 10000
constant_daily = ((1 + annual_pretax) ** (1 / sessions_per_year) - 1) * 10000
output["a2"] = {
    "equal_positive_full_year_required_pretax_return": annual_pretax,
    "linearized_net_bp_per_session": linear_daily,
    "constant_daily_geometric_net_bp_per_session": constant_daily,
    "linearized_net_bp_per_trade": linear_daily / q,
    "linearized_gross_bp_per_trade": linear_daily / q + round_trip_bp,
}
published_daily = 0.0621 / sqrt(sessions_per_year) * 10000
output["published_scale"] = {
    "always_long_last_half_hour_annualized_sd": 0.0621,
    "always_long_last_half_hour_daily_sd_bp_using_sqrt252": published_daily,
    "long_short_annualized_sd": 0.0619,
    "long_short_annualized_arithmetic_mean": 0.0667,
    "long_short_arithmetic_mean_bp_per_session": 0.0667 / sessions_per_year * 10000,
    "half_exposure_equal_conditional_second_moment_negligible_mean_proxy_sd_bp": published_daily * sqrt(q),
    "assumed_25bp_relative_to_proxy": sigma_bp / (published_daily * sqrt(q)) - 1,
}
for benchmark in [0.0, 0.03, 0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 0.10, 0.12, 0.15, 0.20]:
    ratio = (1 + after_tax_target) / (1 + benchmark)
    crossing = log(0.85) / log(ratio) if benchmark > after_tax_target else None
    output["relative_stop"].append({
        "assumed_benchmark_after_tax_cagr": benchmark,
        "assumed_sleeve_after_tax_cagr": after_tax_target,
        "continuous_crossing_years_smooth_constant_growth": crossing,
        "first_quarter_check_years_if_inception_quarter_aligned": ceil(4 * crossing) / 4 if crossing else None,
        "relative_wealth_minus_one_at_two_years": ratio ** 2 - 1,
    })
output["relative_stop_boundaries"] = {
    "benchmark_cagr_for_exact_two_year_smooth_crossing": 1.03 / sqrt(0.85) - 1,
    "benchmark_cagr_for_exact_1_75_year_smooth_crossing": 1.03 / 0.85 ** (1 / 1.75) - 1,
}
for label, minutes in [("regular_full_sessions_0930_1600", 390), ("extended_sessions_0400_2000", 960), ("24_hour_bound_per_assumed_date", 1440)]:
    bars = N * minutes
    pages = ceil(bars / 10000)
    output["pages_per_feed"].append({"label": label, "assumed_dates": N, "minutes_per_date": minutes, "maximum_one_minute_bars_on_assumed_dates": bars, "full_10000_row_page_equivalents_rounded_up": pages})
    assert pages * 10000 >= bars > (pages - 1) * 10000
for m in [1, 5, 10, 20, 100]:
    output["repeated_test_illustrations"].append({
        "hypothetical_null_tests": m,
        "independent_familywise_rejection_probability": 1 - (1 - alpha) ** m,
        "union_bound_arbitrary_dependence_if_marginal_levels_valid": min(1.0, m * alpha),
    })
for rho in [0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3]:
    output["hac_ar1_illustrations"].append({
        "assumed_rho": rho,
        "infinite_ar1_long_run_sd_multiplier": sqrt((1 + rho) / (1 - rho)),
        "five_lag_bartlett_sd_multiplier_before_small_sample_correction": sqrt(1 + 2 * sum((1 - k / 6) * rho ** k for k in range(1, 6))),
    })
assert abs(output["a1"]["nominal_mean_over_se_3_net_bp_per_session"] / se - 3) < 1e-12
assert abs(annual_pretax * (1 - tax) - after_tax_target) < 1e-12
assert abs(((1 + constant_daily / 10000) ** sessions_per_year - 1) * (1 - tax) - after_tax_target) < 1e-12
assert output["mde"][1]["normal_net_bp_per_session"] > output["mde"][0]["normal_net_bp_per_session"] > threshold * se
self_checks: Passed expected hash, solved power tolerance, daily/annual tax identities, t identity, ordered MDEs and page-ceiling bounds. Re-run reproduction_python with recorded existing interpreter; output variable is the calculated object.
limitations: Official eligible-calendar count, exposure fraction, candidate volatility, covariance, signal frequency, strategy returns, power and pass rate were not measured. An offline library full-session count is separately labeled.
Published 1993-2013 unconditional half-hour statistics do not identify conditional long-only moments or 2016-2026 regimes.
Power concerns A1 under explicit reference models only, not the joint A1-and-tax-path-A2 pass probability.
All-session bounds cover the same assumed date set only; continuous ranges can include extra half-days and overnight dates and must be sized after calendar/query design.
No data pull, scorer, protocol change, shadow or live action authorized by this verification.

offline_calendar_cross_check.reproduction_python:
import pandas_market_calendars as mcal
from hashlib import sha256
for start in ['2016-01-04', '2016-01-05']:
    schedule=mcal.get_calendar('NYSE').schedule(start_date=start,end_date='2026-09-30')
    minutes=(schedule.market_close-schedule.market_open).dt.total_seconds()/60
    print(start,len(schedule),int((minutes==390).sum()),int((minutes<390).sum()),int(minutes.sum()),sha256(schedule.to_csv().encode()).hexdigest())
offline_calendar_cross_check.limitation: Library rule-based schedule is an offline cross-check only. Full 390-minute sessions are not automatically data-eligible sessions. Main Opus arithmetic keeps its original N=2670 assumption for faithful reproduction.
